results.id: L|Package\Update close date where not exist in file|title
results.detail: flow_he[1] reproduces the SQL exactly. short_he says that every open warning note not marked 'exists in file' today is closed. The statement updates only rows with gen_existinfile = 0 AND gen_closedate IS NULL, and the reset step only changes 1 to 0. A note whose gen_existinfile is NULL is not marked, yet it is never closed. NULL can come from notes not created by this package or from data that existed before the attribute; the attribute default and the CRM data are not supplied, so this must be stated as a condition. The title itself mirrors the task name and is acceptable. The close value is User::LastBusinessDate: yesterday, moved back while the date matches a CalendarRule row named Friday/Saturday/Holiday, then ToUniversalTime. The 'last business day' label is backed by that script.
